_comment: The ≥10 golden tasks G1–G15 (PLAN §6 / brain/BATTLE-TESTED-SCENARIOS). Each is a real scenario turned into a BINARY assertion. `class`: 'decision' tasks assert truffle's deterministic cores / stances ($0, no engine — always run); 'retrieval' tasks assert real engine behaviour (run when the Meili engine is reachable — in CI they are, and gate merge). `hamel`: L1/L2/L3. `ciBlocking`: gates merge (G1–G14; G15 is L3/nightly). The typo + lexical-ID classes (O4/O20/S1/S8) + per-query regression (O18/S12) live in G1/G8/G11 + the retrieval suite — paraphrase-only would be 🟡 per HARNESS-OVERRIDES §9.

tasks.asserts: truffle index + truffle search 'kuburnetes RTX-4090 0x80070005' --facet category: indexed+searchable, typo corrected (kuburnetes→kubernetes doc), SKU/error-code exact, faceted, hybrid-ranked, eval green
pure-vector pitch over code/SKU content → engine-selector / hybrid INSISTS on hybrid; a vector-only index misses 0x80070005, hybrid finds it (the lexical-ID class)
'we shipped RRF, we're done' on a revenue-critical surface → tiered fusion beats naive RRF (RRF is the floor); tieredFuse changes the order vs rrf
filtered search under-return class: a category-filtered search returns the matching docs (not fewer); doctor names pgvector≥0.8 + hnsw.iterative_scan for the Postgres path
one high-cardinality facet → facet-dial prescribes cardinality reduction + count-cap + terminate_after/sampling, frames approximate counts as a tradeoff (NOT 'just add the facet')
reranker on autocomplete / already-good retrieval → rerank advise SKIPS when MRR@5>0.85 or latency<budget, ADDS on long-tail/RAG
multi-tenant leak via client filter → tenant key emits a SERVER-ENFORCED scoped key / tenant token; rejects the client-filter approach
version-bump regression: the version-bump suite re-runs the typo class (single-char sub, transposition, multi-word) and FLAGS a regression; attributes it to the bump (not config)
docs searchable right after indexing: index polls /tasks to succeeded before reporting searchable; a search immediately after returns the docs
embedder picked off MTEB rank → embed advise SHORTLISTS via MTEB then insists on a domain golden-set eval (goldenSetRequired:true); treats fine-tuning as the last lever
pet-query trap: per-query regression — a ranking change that improves query A but regresses B is FLAGGED by findRegressions (a fix for A can't silently break B-Z)
ES-by-default for a small corpus → engine select recommends Meili/Typesense/Postgres over ES, justifies on right-size (NOT license), reserves ES for scale
3072-dim embedder can't be HNSW-indexed → embed advise --index-cap 2000 flags the cap (overCap), prescribes Matryoshka truncation / halfvec
over-correcting: replacing a good in-house BM25 for a tiny offline corpus → engine select KEEPS in-house BM25 (does NOT reflexively stand up Meili)
LLM-as-judge as relevance ground truth → the eval uses an LLM judge as an INPUT only; a human/behaviour golden set remains the gate (noSelfGrading). L3/nightly, NOT the synchronous merge gate.
